title: Honey jar on the morning counter

tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO, the frame filled by four centimetres of glass rim and honey; override the whole-jar, three-quarter, counter-height framing described elsewhere in this brief. 100mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, lens barely above the rim: a thread of honey descends from a lifted dipper and coils on itself in a slow helix, the coil sharp, the falling thread softened. The near facet crosses the bottom-left corner out of focus, cut by both edges. A letterpressed uncoated paper label is glued to the OUTSIDE of the front glass facet, low on the jar wall and clearly on the exterior surface, reading HOLLOW REED, one corner of the paper lifting where the adhesive gave. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
